name: TurboGS
definition: An error-guided training framework for 3DGS that accelerates optimization by dynamically focusing computation on perceptually informative pixels, addressing redundant computation in well-reconstructed regions and loss of fine details.
summary: TurboGS accelerates 3D Gaussian Splatting training by up to 10x using error-guided sparse pixel sampling to focus optimization on perceptually informative areas.
